lead_raw_text:
The Ba2K3Ti6O20 structure (BaK3Ti3O10) is tetragonal with space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), containing 32 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ti as octahedral, coordinated by six O neighbors, while K adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement. TiO6 octahedra share corners and edges with one another, and with Ba-centered 10-vertex polyhedra; Ba and K polyhedra additionally share corners. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
